sponsorsystem.error.unavailable: The sponsorship system is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
sponsorsystem.error.players_only: Only a player can run this command. From the console, use /sponsorship instead.
sponsorsystem.error.not_in_graph: %s is not part of the support graph.
sponsorsystem.error.self_not_in_graph: You are not part of the support graph yet. An operator can add you with /sponsorship adopt.
sponsorsystem.error.save_failed: Could not save the support graph, so nothing was changed. Check the server log.
sponsorsystem.error.self_revoked: Your own place here was revoked, so you cannot back anyone else.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.invalid_name: %s is not a valid Minecraft username.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.not_found: There is no Minecraft account called %s.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.unavailable: Could not verify %s right now. Try again in a moment.
sponsorsystem.error.lookup.offline_mode: This server is in offline mode, so usernames cannot be verified. An operator must enable allowOfflineModeUuids in the config.
sponsorsystem.bootstrap.rejected: This server is waiting for its founder to claim it. You cannot join yet.
sponsorsystem.bootstrap.claimed: You are now the root of the support graph. The whitelist is on and this server is closed to everyone you do not vouch for.
sponsorsystem.bootstrap.claimed_detail: Invite someone with /invite <name>. Whoever you back is your responsibility.
sponsorsystem.bootstrap.save_failed: Could not save the support graph, so your claim was undone. Check the server log and reconnect.
sponsorsystem.tickets.none_left: You have no support tickets left. You may back %s players at a time; withdraw from someone first.
sponsorsystem.support.lost: Nobody is backing you any more. You have %s minute(s) of playtime to find a new supporter before you lose access.
sponsorsystem.support.expired_announce: %s ran out of time with nobody backing them and has been removed.
sponsorsystem.support.lost_on_join: Nobody is backing you. You have %s minute(s) of playtime left before you lose access.
sponsorsystem.support.lost_on_join_detai: The countdown only runs while you are online. Ask someone to /sponsor you.
sponsorsystem.support.restored_by: %s is backing you. You have support again.
sponsorsystem.invite.success: %s is now whitelisted, and you are backing them. What they do is on you.
sponsorsystem.invite.already_here: %s is already on this server. Use /sponsor %s to back them as well.
sponsorsystem.invite.cooldown: You invited someone recently. Try again in %s minute(s).
sponsorsystem.invite.playtime: You need %s minute(s) of playtime before you can back anyone. You have %s.
sponsorsystem.invite.not_in_graph: You are not part of the support graph, so you cannot back anyone. Ask an operator to add you with /sponsorship adopt.
sponsorsystem.invite.bootstrap_in_progre: This server has not been claimed yet. The founder claims it by joining, not with this command.
sponsorsystem.invite.bootstrapped: The support graph had no entry for you, so you have been added as a root.
sponsorsystem.sponsor.success: You are now backing %s. You are as answerable for them as everyone else who backs them.
sponsorsystem.sponsor.rescued: You are now backing %s, and they are no longer abandoned.
sponsorsystem.sponsor.announce_rescue: %s stepped in to back %s, who had nobody left.
sponsorsystem.sponsor.not_here: %s is not on this server yet. Use /invite to bring them in.
sponsorsystem.withdraw.success: You have withdrawn your support for %s.
sponsorsystem.withdraw.not_yours: You are not backing %s, so there is nothing to withdraw.
sponsorsystem.withdraw.too_young: You cannot withdraw that support yet.
sponsorsystem.withdraw.too_young_wait: You only recently started backing %s. You can withdraw in %s minute(s).
sponsorsystem.withdraw.confirm_warning: Careful: you are the only one backing %s. Withdrawing will leave them with nobody.
sponsorsystem.withdraw.promoted: %s is still backed by %s, so the tree now draws them from there. Nothing about who is responsible has changed.
sponsorsystem.kick.revoked_by_admin: An operator revoked your place on this server.
sponsorsystem.kick.expired: Your invite expired before you used it. Ask whoever invited you to try again.
sponsorsystem.kick.support_expired: Nobody was backing you when your grace period ran out, so you have been removed. You can come back if somebody invites you again.
sponsorsystem.grace.warning: Nobody is backing you. %s minute(s) of playtime left before you lose access - ask someone to /sponsor you.
sponsorsystem.mysponsors.players_only: This command shows your own relationships, so only a player can run it. Operators can inspect anyone with /invitetree.
sponsorsystem.mysponsors.grace: Time left before you lose access: %s
sponsorsystem.mysponsors.you_are_root: You are a root of the graph. Nobody backs you, and nobody needs to.
sponsorsystem.mysponsors.equal_note: Everyone listed above is equally answerable for you.
sponsorsystem.admin.reload.warnings: %s problem(s) were repaired while loading. See the server log.
sponsorsystem.admin.reload.failed: Could not read sponsors.json. The graph was left as it was; check the server log.
sponsorsystem.admin.adopt.root: Adopted %s into the graph as a root.
sponsorsystem.admin.adopt.under: Adopted %s into the graph, backed by %s.
sponsorsystem.admin.revoke.stranded: %s other player(s) lost their support as a result.
sponsorsystem.admin.error.already: %s is already in the graph. Use /sponsorship reassign to move them.
sponsorsystem.admin.stats.edges: Support edges: %s, of which %s are sponsorships.
sponsorsystem.admin.stats.whitelist: Whitelisted: %s, of which %s are not in the graph.
sponsorsystem.admin.stats.orphan_hint: Bring those into the graph with /sponsorship adopt <player> [supporter].
sponsorsystem.admin.stats.whitelist_off: The whitelist is currently OFF, so none of this is being enforced.
sponsorsystem.debug.graph: Graph: %s players, %s edges, %s root(s), deepest chain %s
sponsorsystem.debug.sync: Sync: %s live not whitelisted, %s revoked still whitelisted, %s whitelisted with no entry
sponsorsystem.debug.edges_legend: (* marks the primary edge - who originally invited them)
sponsorsystem.configuration.title: Sponsorship
sponsorsystem.configuration.abandonedCou: Show the countdown on the action bar
sponsorsystem.configuration.bootstrap.en: Let the first player claim the root
sponsorsystem.configuration.bootstrap.re: Only this name may claim the root
